assets.title: HOMS Assessment Desk hero
assets.purpose: website hero and campaign key art
assets.prompt: Create a single photorealistic 16:9 commercial key-art image for a South African educator assessment service. Show an educator at a clean desk reviewing a coherent set of real-looking work artifacts: learner scripts with handwritten answers, a rubric, a marksheet grid, and a professionally formatted exam paper with a memorandum. The documents must look materially real, detailed and connected to one workflow, but contain no readable names or private learner information. Use natural daylight, restrained charcoal, paper white, muted teal and one warm amber accent. The educator remains visibly in control. Full-bleed editorial photography, practical and trustworthy. No text, no logos, no presentation slide, no infographic, no floating cards, no dashboard, no collage, no PowerPoint template.

assets.title: HOMS Marking Relief proof
assets.prompt: Create one realistic overhead 16:9 documentary photograph of an assessment marking workflow. On the left: a small batch of anonymised learner scripts and a concise rubric. In the centre: an educator's hand checking nuanced feedback. On the right: a clean marked gradebook and lecturer review summary. Make the before-to-review progression obvious through physical arrangement, not arrows or labels. Papers must have plausible lines, ticks and tables but no readable personal data. Crisp editorial lighting, white paper, graphite, restrained teal and amber details. No visible headline, no logos, no boxes, no infographic, no slide design, no artificial UI panels.

assets.title: HOMS Exam Studio proof
assets.prompt: Create a single high-end 16:9 editorial photograph showing a CAPS-aware assessment production desk. Include a South African curriculum document with non-readable text, a grade-and-term planning sheet, a polished exam paper, a matching memorandum, and one subject-appropriate source extract or scientific diagram. The outputs should visibly belong together and look professionally typeset. A subject expert is reviewing the final paper with a pen. Use clear neutral light, charcoal, white, muted blue-green and amber. No readable brands, no learner data, no headline, no logos, no presentation, no infographic, no floating cards, no generic template layout.

assets.title: HOMS One-Topic Companion
assets.prompt: Create one photorealistic 16:9 editorial scene of a coherent South African Grade 9 Natural Sciences topic companion pack about electrical circuits. Show a concise concept guide, a clearly labelled circuit diagram, a hands-on activity sheet, a worksheet, a short assessment and its memorandum arranged as one visibly connected sequence. A teacher is checking alignment between the diagram, questions and answer key. Documents should look detailed and usable but contain no learner names. Natural classroom worktable, white paper, graphite, restrained teal and yellow accents. No headline, no logos, no slide deck, no floating cards, no generic template, no disconnected stock images.

assets.title: HOMS Video Lesson Pack
assets.purpose: faceless extra-class video lesson campaign creative
assets.prompt: Create one realistic 16:9 production scene for a faceless curriculum video lesson. Show a laptop previewing a clear electrical-circuit explanation with a real labelled diagram, beside a matching storyboard, narration script, worksheet and short assessment. A compact audio timeline and headphones indicate a voiced, captioned lesson, while the paper materials visibly test the same topic. No presenter face is required. Use a practical educator workspace, crisp neutral light, charcoal, white, green and yellow details. No readable brand, no headline, no presentation slide, no floating UI cards, no fake dashboard, no generic PowerPoint composition.
